title: Pressure Plate hazard module — cells that fire events when occupied (third hazard from gameplay-systems §11)
intent: Third hazard module after Conveyor Belt (S146) and Warp Hole (S149). A pressure plate is a single grid cell tagged with a TRIGGER ACTION; when any bomber (or bomb) stands on the cell, the action fires. Three starter action types: 'spawn-bomb' (a fresh bomb appears on a configured cell), 'open-gate' (a designated hard-block flips to empty for N seconds), 'arena-event' (broadcast event other systems can subscribe to). Single-cell + simple state machine — sets a more LOGIC-DRIVEN hazard pattern alongside the movement-driven Conveyor and teleport-driven Warp. Three different hazard archetypes give arena authors a real vocabulary for designing scripted moments without per-arena code.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/gameplay-systems.md §11` (Pressure Plate: Wait — 'interesting in objective rounds'). The 'wait until objective rounds exist' rationale was speculative; pressure plates are useful on their own as arena-author building blocks (a moving target the bomber must reach to spawn a power-up bomb, a hidden gate that opens when a specific cell is occupied). Continues the content variety direction — third hazard module within 3 sprints rounds out a meaningful arena-author kit. Marked `could` because the hazard pattern is well-established; this is incremental.
acceptanceHints: Builds on the pattern established by GDP-2026-05-26-003 Conveyor (S146) + GDP-2026-05-27-004 Warp Hole (S149). Same shape: schema component + project-local system + scene authoring + bench preview.
examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json:
PressurePlate component {
plateId: integer,
triggerAction: 'spawn-bomb' | 'open-gate' | 'arena-event',
cooldownMs: 500..5000 (default 1000),
actionPayload: {
// spawn-bomb: { spawnGx, spawnGz, range, fuseS }
// open-gate: { gateEntityId, durationMs }
// arena-event: { eventName }
Plate is placed on a cell entity; bombers + bombs entering the cell trigger.
examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/pressure-plate-system.ts: NEW.
Query: entities with GridPosition + PressurePlate.
Each fixedUpdate, for each plate: check if any bomber or bomb is on the plate's grid cell (GridOccupancy query).
If occupied AND plate.lastTriggerAt < now - plate.cooldownMs: fire the trigger action + update lastTriggerAt.

spawn-bomb action: spawn a Bomb entity at actionPayload.spawnGx/Gz with range + fuseRemaining from payload. ownerId = the plate's own entity id (or a configurable trigger-owner field). The spawn-bomb cell's blast can kill anyone — including the player who triggered.
open-gate action: flip the gateEntity's hard-block-component OFF for durationMs, then back ON. During the off window, bombers + blasts pass through.
arena-event action: emit a `arena-event` ECS command/event with the payload's eventName. Other project-local systems can subscribe (allows arena authors to chain plates → custom logic).
VISUAL TREATMENT:

Plate cells use a new flat-disc mesh on the floor (~0.05 cell thick, fills the cell). When idle: muted yellow with cream stripe accent. When triggered (visual feedback): brief flash to bright cream + fade to muted yellow over 0.3s.
Cooldown indicator: when on cooldown, the disc dims to 30% opacity for the cooldown duration.
Reuse the `hazard-stripes` shader from S146 (Conveyor) for the stripe accent — keeps visual family.
AUDIO: new event `plate-click` — quick mechanical clack on trigger. Reuses existing audio-fx graph; one short clip.
GAMEPLAY IMPLICATIONS:

Plate cell with spawn-bomb action: a bomb appears at the configured location each time the cell is stepped on (+ cooldown). Players learn 'stay off that cell' OR 'use it offensively to attack opponent's lane'.
Plate cell with open-gate action: opens a 1-cell hard-block opening for durationMs. Creates risk/reward — running to the plate exposes you to opponent fire, but opens a flanking route.
Plate cell with arena-event: emits ECS event; project arena code can wire it to anything (multi-plate puzzles, etc.).
Plate cells DON'T block movement themselves. Bombers can walk over them freely. The trigger is the occupancy.
Plate cells SURVIVE blasts (same as Conveyor + Warp).
Multiple plates triggered same tick: independent triggers, deterministic order by plate.plateId.
BOT AI:

Bot AI sees plate cells as 'neutral travel cost' (don't avoid by default). For spawn-bomb plates, bot's danger-map weights the plate's spawn-target cell as future-danger after-trigger, so bots near a spawn-target cell avoid passing over the plate.
Stretch: bot uses open-gate plates strategically when chasing player (open gate to flank).
Initial cut: bot ignores plates' triggers in decision-making but evaluates resulting consequences. Sufficient for v1.
MULTIPLAYER (server-authoritative, post-S125):
Server runs pressure-plate-system + the resulting spawn-bomb / open-gate / arena-event side-effects. Snapshot reflects gate-state changes + spawned bombs.
Cooldown timing is server wall-clock per plate.
AUTHORING — initial cut, arena suggestions:
scenes/start.scene.json: NO plates (preserves baseline).
scenes/cross.scene.json: ONE plate at the centre plaza with arena-event 'cross-centre-touched' (proof-of-concept hook, no consumer in v1 — sets up future per-arena scripting).
scenes/pit.scene.json: ONE plate inside the ring with open-gate action — touching opens a corner hard-block for 3s (creates a risky escape route).
Optional new arena 'plate-puzzle.scene.json' — 4 plates spawning bombs at the central cell when stepped on. Showcases the module.
UNIT TESTS:
Bomber walks onto plate-spawn-bomb cell → bomb spawns at payload.spawnGx/Gz next fixedUpdate.
Bomber walks onto plate-open-gate cell → gate entity's hard-block-component flips false for durationMs.
Bomber walks onto plate-arena-event cell → ECS event emitted with eventName.
Cooldown enforced: bomber stays on plate → trigger fires once, then cooldownMs elapses, then fires again. Three triggers across 2× cooldownMs.
Multiple plates with same plateId: schema rejects at engine:check.
Plate survives blast: BlastTile passes over plate without destroying it; plate continues to trigger.
DETERMINISM: plate decisions are deterministic per cell entry; cooldown uses server wall-clock per plate. Bot-vs-bot regression continues to resolve within budget.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Plate that requires WEIGHT (multiple bombers on plate to trigger). Single-entity-triggers in v1.
Plate that fires only on PRESSING (start-of-stand) vs CONTINUOUS occupation. Initial cut is continuous + cooldown — simpler.
Plate with VISIBILITY toggle (hidden plate revealed by hover). Plates are always visible.
Plate-triggered custom systems beyond the 3 actions (custom scripting). The arena-event action is the extensibility hook.
Player-buildable plates (level editor adjacent). Defer indefinitely.
Pressure-plate + Bomb-Rail combo (bombs sliding over plates). Bomb Rail is a separate hazard, not in this story.
